question: Subha Mudgal is famous for which of the following music forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindustani music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian **musician**, **composer**, **vocalist**, and multi-instrumentalist **Shubha Mudgal **was **born **in **1959 **and is well-known for her contributions to Tamil film, Indian pop music, and **Hindustani classical music**.
 
• She is skilled in the **khyal**, **thumri**, and **dadra **genres.
 
• In **2000**, she was awarded the **Padma Shri**.
 
• **Hindustani classical music**:
 
 
• The classical **music of the northern parts of the Indian subcontinent** is known as Hindustani classical music. It is **also known** as **shastriya sangeet in Hindustani **or North Indian classical music.
 
• In addition to referring to Indian classical music generally, the term **"shastriya sangeet"** literally means** "classical music.**"
 
• Instruments like the **veena**, **sitar**, and **sarod **are used to play it.
 
• It **began **in the **12th century CE**, when it **separated from the South Indian classical style** known as **Carnatic music**.
 
• Hindustani music mostly **employs works **written **in Urdu**, **Punjabi**, **Rajasthani**, and **occasionally Hindi**, whereas Carnatic music mostly uses tunes written in Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, and occasionally Sanskrit.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carnatic music**: This is a **separate classical music tradition originating in south India**.

 
 
• While both Hindustani and Carnatic music share some similarities, they have distinct styles and melodic structures.
 
 
 
• **Reggae music**: This is a genre of **popular music originated** in **Jamaica**, known for its offbeat rhythm and **use of basslines**.
 
• **Hip hop music**: This is a genre of **popular music developed **in the **United States**, characterized by **rapping**, **DJing**, and **breakdancing**.
